key.name: check-interval
key.summary: Interval between updates check
key.description: Time to wait between two automatic checks

key.name: interval-unit
key.summary: Unit to use for the interval
key.description: 0:hours, 1:days, 2:weeks

key.name: always-visible
key.summary: Indicator is always visble
key.description: If true, the indicator is always visible, even when non updates are pending

key.name: show-count
key.summary: Show updates count on indicator
key.description: If true, the indicator will display the number of updates pending

key.name: notify
key.summary: Send a notification when new updates are available
key.description: Send a notification when new updates are available

key.name: verbosity
key.summary: How much information to show on notifications
key.description: 0:Count only, 1:New updates names, 2:All updates names

key.name: transient
key.summary: Use transient notifications (auto dismiss)

key.name: use-shortcut
key.summary: Use a shortcut to open the indicator.

key.name: debian-updates-indicator-shortcut
key.summary: Keybinding to open the indicator.
key.description: If showing, the indicator menu is toggled.

key.name: use-custom-cmd
key.summary: Allow checks for updates without a passwrd

key.name: check-cmd-custom
key.summary: Custom command to run to check for updates
key.description: Command to run to check for updates.

key.name: update-cmd-options
key.summary: Application to use to update, or custom command
key.description: 0: GNOME Software, 1: Synaptic, 2: PackageKit, 3: Ubuntu Update Manager, 4: custom, 5: APT default terminal, 6: Nala XFCE Terminal, 7: APT-get default terminal

key.name: update-cmd
key.summary: Command to run to update packages.
key.description: Command to run to update packages.

key.name: output-on-terminal
key.summary: Show the output of the upgrade process on a terminal window
key.description: This is a safer way of upgrading packages.

key.name: terminal
key.summary: Terminal and options to use
key.description: Terminal and options to execute a shell for the upgrade process

key.name: cleanup-cmd-options
key.summary: Method used to remove unused packages
key.description: 0: APT default terminal, 1: APT-get default terminal, 2: custom, 3: Nala XFCE Terminal

key.name: cleanup-cmd
key.summary: Custom command to remove unused packages
key.description: Executable and arguments, run interactively in a terminal.

key.name: cleanup-terminal
key.summary: Terminal command prefix for package cleanup
key.description: Custom method only. Leave empty to use the desktop or Debian default terminal. Prefix must accept an executable and arguments and should wait for completion.

key.name: cleanup-purge-residual
key.summary: Also purge residual configuration files
key.description: When manually removing unused packages, also purge retained configuration files. Nala uses autoremove --purge --remove-config; APT and APT-get offer an additional residual purge. Custom commands are unchanged; APT-get handles residuals.

key.name: strip-versions
key.summary: Remove version numbers from checkupdates output

key.name: show-critical-updates
key.summary: Distinguishes security/important updates from regular updates

key.name: auto-expand-list
key.summary: Auto-open list submenu when updates count is lower than this number

key.name: last-check-date-double
key.summary: Date and time of the last time a check for updates was run.
key.description: This is stored and used on the next boot.

key.name: last-check-date-automatic-double
key.summary: Date and time of the last time a check for updates was run automatically.
key.description: This is stored and used on the next boot. Used for calculating when the next check should take place.

key.name: new-packages
key.summary: Show a list of new packages
key.description: When a new package is found in the repository, it is added to a list.

key.name: obsolete-packages
key.summary: Show a list of obsolete packages
key.description: When an obsolete package is found, it is added to a list.

key.name: residual-packages
key.summary: Show a list of residual packages
key.description: When config files from package are not deleted after removal, the package is added to a list.

key.name: autoremovable-packages
key.summary: Show a list of autoremovable packages
key.description: When a package is no longer required, it is added to a list.

key.name: ignore-list
key.summary: Packages to ignore list
key.description: A list of packages to ignore for updates.
